label: #3619127: sidebar opens from Inline Form Errors links (MR + vanilla JS), pinned core
description: Before: upstream main. After: MR !16895 with patch-0 (no jQuery) and patch-1 (no persist). Open /node/add/article in a narrow window, set a URL alias of 'no-slash' inside the sidebar, close the sidebar, Save, then use the error link. Before: nothing opens. After: the sidebar opens and the field gets focus.

steps.text: Default Admin is the admin theme.
Article content type and the Path module (URL alias field) are installed.
The Inline Form Errors module is enabled.
Open /node/add/article (the page is already loaded in both frames once you press Go).
Use the Tablet or Phone frame width, so the sidebar of advanced fields is collapsed.
Open "URL alias" and type a value without a leading slash, for example no-slash.
Click Save. An error appears at the top: "1 error has been found: URL alias", with "URL alias" as a link.
steps.lookFor: An error summary at the top of the page, with "URL alias" as a link. If you do not see it, the setup went wrong; try again from step 6.

steps.text: Turn Mirror off. In EACH frame, click the "URL alias" link with a REAL mouse click (then repeat using only the keyboard: Tab to the link, press Enter). Do not use a script: script-generated clicks do not trigger the focus behaviour being tested.
steps.lookFor: Before: nothing visibly happens. After: the sidebar opens and the URL alias box is outlined (it has keyboard focus). Then press Run checks.

expected: The sidebar opens and keyboard focus moves to the invalid URL alias field.
actual: Before (upstream main): nothing happens. After (with the change): the sidebar opens and the field has focus.
setup: scripts/lab-site.sh reset <env> (or apply <env>) gives a site in the starting state for steps 1 to 3.

checks.label: Setup reached: error link to URL alias is on the page
The error link was used with a real click or key press, not a script
Sidebar is open after using the error link
URL alias field received keyboard focus (recorded when it happens: only one frame can hold focus at a time)
Saved sidebar preference was not overwritten (phone/tablet key)
JavaScript errors on the page (ignoring the harmless "ResizeObserver loop" notice)
Number of open details sections matches the other side

observe.label: The sidebar of advanced fields opened by itself
The "URL alias" section is open and the field is visible without scrolling
The "URL alias" field has a visible focus outline
Anything else looks broken or different (layout, colours, errors)

pinnedNote: Core commit d29add7ebc1 (2026-09-30), the one the evidence in reports/issues/3619127/ was produced on. Reproduces exactly as verified.
